hooks.prompt:
Check if the file being edited is in the autoload/ directory (e.g., autoload/claude-multi-status.el, autoload/claude-multi-agents.el, etc.) OR is config.el. If it is, run the syntax validation tests using: ./test/run-syntax-tests.sh

This ensures parenthesis balance and module loading are correct after every edit. If tests fail, report the errors to the user and suggest fixes.

hooks.description: Final syntax validation check before session ends
